title: Fungsui Culture Lecture Explores Zhuangzi's Realm of Freedom - Enthusiastic Reception Collaborating with SeerQ to Promote Taoist Wisdom of Carefree Living-Finland Weekly-A boutique key news website integrating authority, practicality and immediacy
text: 2026-07-08 Hong Kong, July 6, 2026 – The "2026 Lecture Series on I-Ching and Taoist Education," organized by the Hong Kong Taoist Federation, co-organized by the Yuen Yuen Institute, and assisted by the Taoist Ming Sin College, was successfully held on the evening of Saturday, July 4, at the Lecture Theatre of the Hong Kong Central Library. The lecture featured Master Brother of Fungsui Culture as the keynote speaker, presenting the topic "Zhuangzi: The Taoist Realm of Freedom." The event attracted numerous fellow practitioners and members of the public, with a full house and an overwhelmingly positive response. Zhuangzi's Wisdom: The Key to Unshackling from Worldly Constraints During the lecture, Master Brother explained in an accessible yet profound manner how Zhuangzi's philosophy serves as a key to freeing oneself from worldly shackles. He pointed out that modern individuals are often bound by gain and loss, as well as anxiety, while Zhuangzi's advocacy of "Free and Easy Wandering" embodies the great wisdom of pursuing spiritual ease and freedom. The attendees listened with great attention and actively shared their insights during the Q&A session, creating an atmosphere of harmony and enrichment. Fungsui Culture Partners with SeerQ to Promote Modernization of Traditional Culture As a pioneer dedicated to promoting traditional Chinese culture, Fungsui Culture has been actively disseminating Taoist thought through lectures and new media platforms. This lecture also reflected the collaborative relationship between Fungsui Culture and the SeerQ platform. SeerQ, as a global Chinese-oriented platform for traditional culture and divination consultation, brings together a number of renowned scholars, including Master Brother. Additionally, SeerQ, which supported this lecture as an emerging cultural technology partner, provided various forms of support for the event. Through physical lectures and multi-party collaboration, the wisdom of the ancients has been further integrated into modern life. Widespread Support from Multiple Organizations – Lecture Concludes Successfully The smooth execution of this event was made possible with the strong support of various co-organizers and supporting units. Mr. Wong Shing Yik, Vice Chairman and Event Coordinator, expressed his delight at the event's success and hoped to continue promoting more public activities that further Taoist education in the future. The lecture concluded with warm applause, and attendees left with enriched minds and a sense of Taoist calm and freedom. Fungsui Culture, led by Master Brother, has long been promoting traditional Chinese culture and Taoist wisdom through lectures and channels such as "Fungsui TaoTV." This lecture was also part of the collaboration between Fungsui Culture and the SeerQ platform to promote traditional culture, and it is hoped that more inspiring events for the public will follow.
